name: TYK Medicines, Inc
summary: TYK Medicines, Inc is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company that seeks to discover, acquire, develop and commercialise new oncology treatments for unmet medical needs. Its lead candidate, TY-9591, is a third-generation EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor being developed for EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer that has spread to the brain.
